name: What defines a resort-style pool?
description: A resort-style pool features luxurious designs, amenities like waterfalls or grottoes, and extensive landscaping to create a high-end vacation experience in you

acceptedAnswer.text: A resort-style pool is characterized by luxurious features and amenities that evoke a high-end vacation experience. This often includes elements like large, irregularly shaped designs, rock formations, waterfalls, grottoes, beach entries, swim-up bars, and integrated spa areas. The surrounding landscape, decking, and lighting are also critical to creating a cohesive, upscale ambiance. The goal is to transform your backyard into a private retreat, focusing on aesthetics, comfort, and entertainment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A resort-style pool features luxurious designs, amenities like waterfalls or grottoes, and extensive landscaping to create a high-end vacation experience in your backyard.
